headline: 20本一天讀完的書單
context: 一位曾任布克獎（Booker Prize）評審的作家，整理出20本能一天內讀完的書單，從詹姆斯・鮑德溫（James Baldwin）、韓江，到一本量子物理入門書都在列。她去年擔任布克獎評審時，得在六個多月內讀完153本小說。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: From novels by James Baldwin and Han Kang to a guide to quantum physics – a former Booker prize judge recommends immersive one-sitting wonders A one-sitting read is typically the domain of the short story – a form that largely depends on a reader’s pure, unbroken attention. But there is some­thing special about the intensity of beginning and ending an entire book in a single day. Of all my reading experiences, these have been among the most memorable. As a judge for last year’s Booker prize, faced with 153 books and just over six months in which to read them, it was my task to try to turn every novel into one that could be read in a day. While I loved the experience, it wasn’t exactly a recipe for satisfying reading. Continue reading...
sources.title: Pressed for time? 20 brilliant books you can read in a day

thread_text:
曾任布克獎（Booker Prize）評審的作家，整理出一份能一天內讀完的書單，一共20本。書單橫跨詹姆斯・鮑德溫（James Baldwin）、韓江的小說，到一本量子物理入門書。她去年當評審時，得在六個多月內讀完153本小說。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 11 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
如果只有一天，你能讀完一本書嗎？一位曾任布克獎（Booker Prize）評審的作家，整理出20本能一天內讀完的書單，橫跨詹姆斯・鮑德溫（James Baldwin）、韓江的小說，到一本量子物理入門書都收在裡面。她去年擔任評審時，得在六個多月內啃完153本小說——這份書單，或許是她苦中作樂的心得。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 11 日發佈的報導。
